description: Runs a stored action once each time its enable turns on: a user action, a system setting or a device's defaults. The action runs outside the program pass.

activation.text: Runs once each time its enable turns on. A pulse from Edge, Every or On event fires it once per pulse; a block with no enable sources fires once, when the program starts.

eno.description: A one-pass pulse on the pass the request was queued. The action's own result is reported afterwards, not by this block.

fields.description: The action to run. A wired action wins over the one in the body. It cannot be empty.
